evals.prompt: 帮我做一个 HTML 演讲 deck，讲我们的新产品 Tier0 Edge Gateway（工业边缘网关），给工厂客户的技术负责人看，中文，8 页左右：封面、行业痛点、产品定位、三个核心能力（协议接入 200+ / 边缘计算低延迟 / 云边协同）、一个部署案例（山东某汽车零部件厂，接入 1200 点位，2 周上线）、量化效果（数据接入成本 -60%，故障响应 15min→2min，OEE +8%）、收尾。产出一个可以直接浏览器打开的文件夹。
evals.expected_output: A self-contained deck folder with index.html in mercy style: 16:9 CSS stage, cqw typography, Tier0 tokens (lime/deep-green), eyebrow+accent-line+title per slide, dark cover/closing, keyboard/click/touch nav, no external CDN, lowercase asset paths.

assertions.text: A single index.html sits at the deck folder root
No external CDN/web-font links (no fonts.googleapis, cdn., unpkg, jsdelivr, external http img/script) — fully self-contained
Typography uses container units (cqw/cqh); headings are NOT sized in px
Content slides use eyebrow + accent-line + title pattern (class="eyebrow" and class="accent-line" present)
At least 2 dark slides (.slide.dark) for cover and closing
Nav script supports keyboard (ArrowRight), click zones, and touch swipe
Tier0 accent colors present: lime #B2ED1D and deep-green #73B200 (case-insensitive)
All media src are relative lowercase-ASCII paths (no leading /, no CJK/spaces/uppercase filenames)
Opens at 390px width with zero JS console errors and no horizontal overflow
Roughly 8 slides (6-10)
Includes required facts: 200+ 协议接入, 1200 点位, 2 周上线, 数据成本 -60%, 故障 15min->2min, OEE +8%

evals.prompt:
把下面这段介绍改成一个 6 页左右的 HTML 演讲 deck（中文，浏览器直接打开那种）：

MercyOps 是我们内部的运维自动化平台。现状：工厂 IT 每天平均处理 40+ 工单，70% 是重复性操作（重启服务、清理磁盘、证书续期）。MercyOps 用剧本（playbook）把这些操作固化，出问题自动诊断自动执行，人只审批高风险动作。上线 3 个月：自动处理率 68%，平均恢复时间从 45 分钟降到 6 分钟，夜间告警人工介入次数 -82%。下一步：接入 LLM 做告警根因分析。
evals.expected_output: A 6-slide deck folder in mercy style summarizing the content: cover, status-quo pain, what it is, how it works, stat wall with the three numbers, next-step closing.

assertions.text: A single index.html sits at the deck folder root
No external CDN/web-font links (no fonts.googleapis, cdn., unpkg, jsdelivr, external http img/script) — fully self-contained
Typography uses container units (cqw/cqh); headings are NOT sized in px
Content slides use eyebrow + accent-line + title pattern (class="eyebrow" and class="accent-line" present)
At least 2 dark slides (.slide.dark) for cover and closing
Nav script supports keyboard (ArrowRight), click zones, and touch swipe
Tier0 accent colors present: lime #B2ED1D and deep-green #73B200 (case-insensitive)
All media src are relative lowercase-ASCII paths (no leading /, no CJK/spaces/uppercase filenames)
Opens at 390px width with zero JS console errors and no horizontal overflow
Roughly 6 slides (5-7)
Includes source facts: 剧本/playbook, 自动处理率 68%, 恢复 45->6 分钟, 夜间告警 -82%, 下一步 LLM 根因分析
